children.text: Made Your Logo With AI? Here Is Why It Breaks and How We Fix It

children.html:
AI image generators are great for brainstorming, and plenty of Austin owners now start there. The catch is that they produce pictures, not logo files. What you download is a low-resolution PNG with soft edges, letters that are often misspelled or made up, uneven shapes, and a background that is not truly transparent.

That works on a phone screen and falls apart at the print shop. We keep the idea you like and rebuild it properly: hand-drawn vector paths, your business name set in a real typeface, balanced proportions and exact CMYK and RGB colors. You get SVG, EPS, AI, PDF and transparent PNG files that work on signs, shirts, vehicles and your website.

children.text: Who Is the Best Logo Designer Near Me in Austin?

children.html:
The best logo designer for you is the one who designs original work for your type of business, shows you real examples, explains pricing upfront and gives you the files you need. When you compare Austin options, check for a portfolio of custom logos rather than templates, clear pricing, the number of concepts and revisions you get, and whether you receive vector files such as AI, EPS and SVG that you fully own.

Logo Design Austin, part of Logo In Hours LLC, works with business owners across Austin and Central Texas remotely by phone, text and email. Custom logos are priced from $125 to $175 depending on complexity, there is no upfront payment, and you receive multiple concepts with revisions before you approve. You can also see our guide on how to choose a logo design company.

Logo design for Downtown (78701), South Congress (78704) and East Austin (78702)

Restaurants, bars, boutiques and creative studios in central Austin compete for attention on busy streets and crowded feeds. We design logos that stay readable on storefront signs and small social avatars alike.

Logos for North Austin and the Domain (78758), Round Rock (78664) and Cedar Park (78613)

Tech companies, medical practices and home service businesses in the northern suburbs often need a logo that looks established on websites, vehicles and proposals. Many of our clients come from Round Rock, Cedar Park, Georgetown, San Marcos and Pflugerville.

Logos for South and Southwest Austin (78745, 78749) and Kyle (78640)

Family businesses, contractors and new shops in the fast-growing south side benefit from bold, friendly logos that work on yard signs, shirts and Google profiles.

How much does a logo cost in Austin?

At Logo Design Austin, custom logo design is priced from $125 to $175. You review concepts first and pay only when you are satisfied. For new businesses, the $950 Business Starter Package adds a basic website and 150 business cards.

What makes a logo work for an Austin business?

Austin is crowded with creative brands, so a logo has to be both distinctive and practical. The strongest marks are simple enough to recognize at a glance, legible from a distance on a storefront or truck, and flexible enough to shrink to a social media icon without losing detail. Good logos also print cleanly in one color, which matters for shirts, stamps and engraved signs. We test every concept against those real uses before you see it.

Do you work with startups and brand-new businesses?

Yes. Many clients come to us before they have a storefront, a website or even a final business name. We can help you compare name options visually, design a logo that grows with you and add business cards, social graphics or a starter website when you are ready.

items.q: How much does a custom logo cost in Austin?
items.a: Custom logo design at Logo Design Austin is priced from $125 to $175, depending on the complexity of the design. There is no upfront charge; you pay after you approve.

items.q: How fast can I get a logo?
items.a: First concepts the same day are often possible for straightforward projects after review. Final timing depends on revisions and how quickly you send feedback.

items.q: Can you fix a logo I made with ChatGPT, Midjourney or Canva?
items.a: Yes. We clean up AI-generated logos by rebuilding them by hand as vector files, correcting the lettering and balancing the shapes. Start with a free audit on our AI logo cleanup page.

items.q: What file formats will I receive?
items.a: You receive JPG and PNG files plus vector formats including SVG, PDF, AI and EPS, so your logo works for printing, signs, embroidery, websites and social media.

items.q: How many concepts and revisions do I get?
items.a: Designers create multiple original concepts, each exploring a different direction, and revisions continue until you are satisfied with the logo.

items.q: Do I need to visit an office?
items.a: No. Projects are handled by phone, text, WhatsApp and email, so you can work with us from anywhere in Austin or Central Texas.
Yes. Once the project is complete and paid, you own the final logo files and can use them anywhere for your business.

items.q: Can you improve my existing logo instead of starting over?
items.a: Yes. Our logo enhancement service refreshes fonts, refines colors and simplifies details while keeping the parts your customers already recognize. You receive updated vector files once you approve.

items.q: Do you create embroidery DST files?
items.a: Yes. We can prepare your logo as a DST file for embroidered shirts, caps and uniforms, along with vector files for print. Straightforward files are often ready the same day.
Yes. We design custom mascot and character logos for sports teams, food brands, apparel lines and local businesses, delivered with the same complete file package.
